title: Hautus criteria for exact controllability and stabilizability of discrete-time backward-structured stochastic linear systems
summary: This paper studies exact controllability and L2-stabilizability of discrete-time backward-structured stochastic linear systems. For each prescribed finite horizon, equivalent characterizations of exact controllability are established in terms of the controllability Gramian, a Kalman-type rank condition, and the reachable subspace. Exact null controllability without a prescribed horizon is then characterized by a finite-dimensional rank condition, and a Hautus-type criterion is derived using positive semidefinite eigenmatrices of a positive operator.
